added.title: 纸艺音乐桌：从空白到唱片机
added.author: Gendia 官方案例
added.prompt:
Image prompt (GPT Image 2):
Vertical 9:16 image, top-down flat lay, photorealistic paper cutout collage filling the entire frame. A dense layered scene built entirely from hand-cut construction paper: at the center, a large record player made of stacked paper shapes — a walnut-brown rectangular base, a black circular vinyl disc with concentric cut rings, a thin tonearm, a small red label at the center. Radiating outward and filling the rest of the frame: a coffee cup with three wavy steam strips, an open book with layered page shapes, a small potted plant with eight separate cut leaves, a stack of three paper albums, a wall clock, a pair of headphones, a table lamp with a triangular shade, five scattered musical notes, a cluster of small stars and dots, and a few thin confetti strips. Every piece has visibly hand-cut uneven scissor edges, matte paper texture, and casts its own soft drop shadow onto the layer below, giving a deeply stacked physical look. Shot straight down from directly above, soft even daylight from the upper left, warm cream paper background, rich muted craft palette of terracotta, mustard, sage, dusty blue and cream, balanced composition with small gaps of background showing through, no text.


Video prompt (Seedance 2.5):
Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, stop motion paper cutout animation. Start on the completely empty cream paper background. Hand-cut paper pieces appear one by one, popping into place with a snappy jittery motion — no fading, no sliding, each piece just lands. Small scattered confetti strips, stars and dots come first around the edges, then the surrounding objects assemble one at a time: the coffee cup with its steam strips, the open book, the potted plant leaves, the album stack, the clock, the headphones, the lamp. Finally the record player builds at the center from the bottom up — base, then the black vinyl disc, then the red label, then the tonearm dropping into place last. The finished composition holds still for the final second while the steam strips and musical notes keep twitching in place. Choppy low frame rate handmade stop motion feel, every piece shifting two or three pixels between frames as if placed by hand. Camera locked straight down from directly above, completely static, no zoom, no pan, no rotation. Lighting and background stay identical throughout.

added.description: Gendia 官方展示的纸艺风音乐桌组装：奶油色空白纸面上，咖啡、书、盆栽与唱片机逐步出现，并非真实手工定格拍摄。原页面提供 GPT Image 2 静态参考图和 Seedance 2.5 动画两阶段提示词，静态图与末帧布局对应；页面可查看参考输入。模型由来源页面注明，未独立复现。逐件出现顺序、细微抖动等并未逐项验证，音轨未独立听验。当前可读来源为官方 front-v3 子域，主域同文及条款访问受限。
